name: web_search
description: Search the web and return result titles, URLs, and snippets. It calls a search API with the agent's own key, so there is nothing to sign in to; a search when no key is configured fails saying so, and is the operator's to fix. Follow a result with web_fetch, or web_browse if the page needs its scripts to run.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 10. It is what the API is asked for, so ask for what you will read.
